analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($104,300) vs SMA5 ($100,038)/SMA20 ($106,473)/SMA50 ($123,098) — trading near the middle band, mixed short-to-mid term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($109,576)/SMA200 ($87,441) — above mid-to-long term trend, confirming strong support base.
· 52-week position (60.4%) + current price level historically in the middle range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.4→46.1) — exiting oversold, continuing in neutral territory, lacking direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (negative→positive) — improving signal while weak convergence persists, trend reversal unconfirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $106,473) — band width 32.10%, moderate volatility, trading around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($82,710) — aligns with 52-week low and Pivot S1, strong support zone.
· Swing resistance ($126,140) — near Bollinger upper band and R1, potential bullish breakout.
· 5-day/20-day price patterns — no clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed, confirming sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.56x) — subdued compared to 5-day average, reducing conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — lacking clear direction, maintaining a wait-and-see approach in a period of reduced volatility.
